title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 2 Clause 77 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 2 Clause 77 - Capital Asset “Capital Asset” means— (a) property of any nature or kind held by any taxpayer, (b) any business or undertaking as a whole or as a unit; (c) any share or stock, However, it shall not include the following matters, namely: (i) any stocks, consumables or raw materials held for the purpose of the taxpayer’s business; (ii) personal goods, such as wearable clothing, gold   ornaments, furniture, fixtures or handicrafts, machinery   and vehicles included in the meaning of immovable property, which are used by the taxpayer or any member of his dependent family only for personal purposes and not for the purpose of his business; Click here to see Bangla version Note: This is unofficial English translation. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail. Moreover, as per Section 345(2) of the Income Tax Act 2023, if there is a conflict between the English and Bengali text, the Bengali text shall prevail.
